recommendations.title: Resolve Massive Budget Under-Delivery and Audit Campaign Settings
recommendations.detail: There is a severe gap between the allocated daily budget of ₱493,500.00 and the actual spend of only ₱100.71. Audit the account immediately for strict bid caps, audience overlaps, billing issues, or an active Account Spend Limit (ASL) that is blocking delivery across your 42 active campaigns.

recommendations.title: Consolidate the 42 Active Campaigns to Prevent Fragmentation
recommendations.detail: Running 42 active campaigns with virtually zero spend prevents Meta's algorithm from exiting the learning phase. Consolidate your budget into 2-3 clean campaigns: one dedicated to Calabarzon (targeting Males 45-54) and one for Metro South (targeting Ages 25-55).

recommendations.title: Relaunch with Proven Xpander GLX Ad and Top Historical Creative
recommendations.detail: Scale the '🚙 03 - Xpander GLX AT | Low DP' ad (which achieved an outstanding 8.22% CTR) combined with the 'Chat with us' creative asset, which has a proven historical Cost per Message of ₱29.18. Focus this mix on the top-performing Calabarzon region.

alerts.message: Severe Under-delivery: Daily spend is only ₱100.71 despite an allocated daily budget of ₱493,500.00 across 42 campaigns. Delivery is almost completely stalled.
Extreme account fragmentation detected. Having 42 active campaigns running on an active monthly spend of under ₱3,000.00 dilutes data and keeps ads trapped in the learning phase.
Historically, the 45-54 Male demographic in Calabarzon is your most efficient audience, yielding 395 messages at a strong Cost per Message of ₱40.28.
